notes: Stories created for Disciplinary History Signal with full coverage: schema, logic, API, tests, integration.

change_log.value: Added unit and integration tests story

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S1.title: Define Disciplinary Signal Schema and Contract
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S1.description: Define a minimal, non-sensitive disciplinary signal schema including presence indicator (boolean), state board lookup URL, and source attribution without exposing full disciplinary records.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S2.title: Implement Disciplinary Signal Extraction Logic
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S2.description: Implement logic to construct state medical board lookup links based on provider state and determine presence of disciplinary signal using available provider metadata without scraping or storing full records.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S3.title: Expose Disciplinary Signal via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include disciplinary signal fields in provider detail response, ensuring alignment with existing response structure and no leakage of sensitive data.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Disciplinary Signal
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S4.description: Create unit tests for link construction and presence logic, and integration tests validating end-to-end inclusion of disciplinary signal in provider detail responses.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S5.title: Integrate Disciplinary Signal into Provider Detail Service Output
EVAL-P-MEASURE-3-S5.description: Integrate disciplinary signal generation into provider_detail_service so it is consistently returned alongside other evaluation signals (credentials, research links).
